Year 7 · Topic

Reading for Meaning

Retrieval, inference, evidence, word choice, character, setting and structure.

Lesson sequence

  1. L1: Retrieval and hook
  2. L2: Core teaching with model
  3. L3: Guided practice
  4. L4: Independent application
  5. L5: Misconception clinic
  6. L6: Assessment and reflection

Applied activity

Choose three words and explain how each shapes impression.

Response rhythm: define → apply → analyse → judge.

Knowledge organiser

InferenceDefine, apply and use accurately.
quotationDefine, apply and use accurately.
connotationDefine, apply and use accurately.
viewpointDefine, apply and use accurately.
evidenceDefine, apply and use accurately.
analysisDefine, apply and use accurately.

Common misconception

  • Retelling instead of analysing.

Teacher pack notes

  • Do Now retrieval.
  • Teacher exposition and model response.
  • Guided practice using success criteria.
  • Independent application, feedback and improvement.
